per_kind_family.method: Benjamini-Hochberg across every signal x kind cell of the quotable rules
per_kind_family.null: each cell vs its own signal's corpus-level recall over the same evaluation half
per_kind_family.verdict: no cell is reported until the family is controlled
per_kind_family.caveat: the family is defined over the signals and kinds this corpus actually measured; a corpus with more arms per kind widens it and lowers every q-value, so a q from one corpus must not be transplanted to another

3.7_oda_recall.clause: 3.7 ODA (cloaking) recall > 0 on the reference battery
3.7_oda_recall.caveat: the best-of-four number is selected over signals, so it is optimistic; the per-signal recall in this report is the authoritative figure. A kind with no evaluation-half assets is reported as not measured, not as zero recall.
